entry.goal: Välj medium och tillstånd. / Select medium and permissions.

web.goal: Kontrollera språk, ombrytning, diakritik och UI. / Review lang, wrapping, accents and UI.

documents.goal: Skilj löptext, rubrik, tabell och presentation. / Distinguish prose, title, table and presentation.

review.goal: Skrivskyddade iakttagelser med källor. / Read-only findings with sources.

font_size: No national default. As a trial for ordinary reading web UI, compare 1rem body and 1.5 line height at the actual root/font; evaluate larger alternatives as reader and medium need. This is a design proposal, not a Swedish standard.
ratio: Build hierarchy with content roles, weight, spacing and actual font. Never transfer a brand scale universally.
